segments.name: Banking operation
products: general equipment leasing and financing business
segments.description: Community bank taking deposits, making loans, purchasing securities and offering trust services to retail and commercial customers.
segments.evidence: Loans and investments provide the majority of revenues in the banking operation.

revenueModel.text: Borrowers pay interest and fees on loans and leases; customers pay service charges, ATM and interchange fees, and wealth management fees.
revenueModel.evidence: Interest and fees on loans accounted for 77% of total revenue for 2025, 75% of total revenue for 2024, and 73% of total revenue for 2023.
